content: torch.lstsq is deprecated in favor of torch.linalg.lstsq and will be removed in a future PyTorch release (v2.0.0). torch.linalg.lstsq has a different signature and returns a namedtuple (solution, residuals, rank, singular_values).
torch.lstsq has been removed from PyTorch 2.0.0. Use torch.linalg.lstsq instead for solving linear least squares problems.
torch.linalg.lstsq(A, B, rcond=None, driver=None) computes the least squares solutions to a linear matrix equation. Introduced as the standard replacement for torch.lstsq.
numpy.float was deprecated in NumPy 1.20.0 and removed in NumPy 1.24.0. Use the standard Python float built-in or numpy.float64 instead.
numpy.float has been removed in NumPy 1.24.0. Using np.float will raise an AttributeError. Use float or np.float64.
numpy.unique_values(x) is newly added in NumPy 2.0.0 as part of the Python Array API standard support. It returns unique values without inverse indices.
scipy.histogram is deprecated and removed from SciPy's main namespace as of 1.12.0. Use numpy.histogram directly.
scipy.misc.comb is deprecated in SciPy 1.3.0 and removed in SciPy 1.4.0. Use scipy.special.comb instead.
scipy.misc.comb has been removed in SciPy 1.4.0. All combinatorial functions are now housed under scipy.special.comb.
DataFrame.append is deprecated since version 1.4.0 and removed in version 2.0.0. Use pandas.concat instead to concatenate multiple DataFrames.
DataFrame.append has been removed in Pandas 2.0.0. Calling df.append() raises AttributeError. Use pandas.concat.
